bugs.text: Goei escorts are only moved inside the boss's 'dive' branch. When the boss's dive ends and it enters 'return', the escorts are left in state 'escort' at ~y=H+40 off-screen, unreachable by bullets, until that boss dies. They still count toward the activeDivers<4 cap, so after two escorted boss dives no enemy dives again, and the stage cannot be cleared until the player kills the leading boss in formation. Also blocks formation breathing (223).
A diver that leaves the bottom returns from the bottom (returnStartY = H+20) instead of re-entering from the top.
e.escorts is never cleared when a boss returns; a tractor-beam dive after an escorted dive still scores 800/1600 on kill instead of 400.
Stage badges only appear for stages numbered exactly 1/5/10/20/30/50 and are never decomposed (stage 7 shows '1' and '5' not 5+1+1); challenge stages are never added to completedStages.

Capture region (~30 px half-width at the player's row) is much wider than the drawn beam early in the beam (~10 px), so the ship is captured while visibly outside the cone; no pull-up animation (655-660).
Captured fighter is destroyed on the boss's first hit in formation rather than when the boss is destroyed.
Formation 'breathing' scales x only and the side-sway never stops once the formation is complete.
Dual fighter halves are 14 px wide but spaced 12 px apart, so they overlap by 2 px.
GAME OVER never returns to the title automatically; gameOverTimer is counted but unused, Enter is required.
sfxEnemyHit is never called and explosion maxFrames is unused (dead code).

summary: Clean, well-organised single file: one state object, fixed-timestep loop, clearly separated update and render functions, Web Audio sounds, and all spec screens (title with score table, STAGE N, READY, challenge results, hit-miss results) present and confirmed by the play-test. The core Galaga feel is there - curved group entries into the correct 4/16/20 formation, divers with aimed fire, two-hit colour-changing bosses, a working tractor beam with capture, rescue, dual fighter and hostile captive. Faithfulness breaks down in details: divers return from the bottom instead of the top, escorts are stranded off-screen after every boss dive (which also starves later dives), the challenge stage is a single arc rather than looping patterns, stage badges do not follow the arcade's counting, breathing is horizontal only, and explosions are a scaled fade rather than frame animation. Sprites are crude blocks rather than recognisable Galaga insects. It plays, and the play-test survived, but a human player will notice the stuck escorts and the dive drought within a stage or two.
